# Feature: Level timer and restart

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Give each level a time limit. The countdown is a real counting clock: it counts down in real time while playing, and every input is recorded with its elapsed time, so the timer value at any step is a function of the session log.

## User Story

**As a** player
**I want** a visible countdown and a restart key
**So that** levels have pressure and a failed run is one keypress to retry.

## High-Level Use Case

The HUD timer ticks down from the level limit. At zero the run is lost with a message. Pressing R (or the restart button) restores position, orbs, keys and timer.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given a running level, when time passes, then the countdown decreases in real time.
- Given the timer reaches zero, then the run ends as lost with a message.
- Given R or the restart button, then position, orbs, keys and timer are restored.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Timer value at any replay step comes from recorded t_ms, never unrecorded wall-clock reads.
- Restart starts a new recorded session.

## UI / Feedback

- HUD countdown display; loss message; restart button.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: a per-level time limit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Countdown ticks from the level limit.
- [ ] Expiry ends the run with a message.
- [ ] Restart restores position/orbs/keys/timer.
- [ ] A timeout loss replays as a loss at the same moment.

## Out of Scope

- Pause behaviour (not specified; out of scope until asked).

## Open Questions

- None.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: none — verified in any level; a short-limit test level may be added by the implementing task if useful. Verification should record play sessions for replay.
